newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire sells Torch stake for 26 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire sells Torch stake for 26 mln stg.

text.p: Yorkshire Electricity Group Plc said on Wednesday it has completed the sale of its 50 percent stake in Torch Telecom, a joint venture between Yorkshire and Kingston Communications of Hull.
Kingston is buying the stake for 26 million stg.
Torch provides business telecommunications services to the Yorkshire region.
Yorkshire had already stated its intention to sell the business to concentrate on its core energy operations.
But in July Yorkshire had said that a deal to sell its shareholding to Kingston had not been running to plan and it had started looking at alternative courses of action.
A spokesman for Yorkshire said the talks with Kingston had restarted since the summer and the group had clinched the sale at two million stg more than originally expected.
Industry sources estimated the group could expect a profit of between eight and 10 million stg from the disposal. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
